description_for_human: Discover current federal opportunities and research historical private-foundation funding prospects.
description_for_model: MANDATORY: Call search_grants for every new grant discovery, recommendation, ranking, or comparison request. Grants.gov records may be current opportunities. IRS 990-PF records are historical private-funder prospects only, and USAspending is historical federal-award context only. Never claim that IRS history is an open application or that eligibility or funding is guaranteed.

functions.name: search_grants
functions.description: Find and transparently rank Grants.gov opportunities and IRS 990-PF historical funder prospects.

functions.name: get_grant_details
functions.description: Get complete normalized grant details and score evidence.

functions.name: rescore_grants
functions.description: Reweight cached results without repeating provider searches.

functions.name: compare_grants
functions.description: Compare two or three grants deterministically.

functions.name: create_grant_watch
functions.description: Create a persistent opportunity watch with Azure Communication Services Email notifications.

functions.name: get_project_ideas
functions.description: Return evidence for Copilot to suggest grounded project concepts.

tools.name: search_grants
tools.description: Use whenever a user wants to find, rank, recommend, or compare grants. Returns the interactive Grant Opportunity Workbench.
